key_insight: Convex conjugacy yields an exact reformulation of logistic-regression poisoning with affine stationarity and bounded bilinear equalities as the only nonconvex constraints.
engineering_relevance: The reformulation supports robustness analysis of ℓ₂-regularized logistic regression by enabling stronger solver bounds on poisoning attacks.
method: Replace the defender’s optimization problem with exact first-order optimality conditions using strong convexity.
Use softplus conjugacy to replace sigmoid relations with one convex optimality-gap inequality and express the attack objective as concave.
Transform variables to make stationarity affine and derive finite bounds, tightened through convex preprocessing.
evidence_signal: Experiments on eight binary classification datasets found that locally optimized attacks degraded performance on most datasets, while the convex-analytic formulation gave substantially stronger reported dual bounds in SCIP within a fixed time limit.
watch_item: Bilinear equalities remain nonconvex, and stronger dual bounds do not by themselves establish globally optimal attacks within the time limit.
paper_title: A Convex-Analytic Reformulation for Poisoning Attacks on Logistic Regression
